baseline_fingerprint.primary_data_source: 东方财富 push2his K-line API (secid=1.600519)
validation: checked that SVG contains no NaN
read back the local artifact first line
baseline_fingerprint.reply_format: Markdown: validation note + metric table + three-stage trend review + technical position + artifact path
baseline_fingerprint.behavior: 1. Probed E2B MCP resources/templates and checked the isolated Python runtime and installed packages; 2. Confirmed the E2B sandbox cannot see the local workspace; 3. Pulled Eastmoney unadjusted daily bars with requests and used pandas/numpy to compute one-year return, extrema, drawdown, volatility, turnover and moving averages; 4. Generated a large SVG in E2B, then rewrote it into a compact SVG representation; 5. Copied the SVG text into a local file through file_write; 6. Validated XML structure, element counts and absence of NaN, then read back the artifact; 7. Returned a staged trend analysis and the SVG path without asking the user for clarification.
